purpose: Which stakeholder kinds exist and their words, read from the GilbVeda master in as few requests as it allows, kept across sessions, and shared by every reader in a page.
namedChanges: the imports of the source's own files lose `.ts` (`./kinds`, `./predicates`, `./vocabularyStore`; `./vocabulary.ts` is `./vocabularyStore`), and the imports of `./terms.ts`, `./source.ts` and `./deadline.ts` are one import of the peer `vocabulary-source`; since 0.2.0 no import of a symbol is dropped (`resolvePredicates`, `VocabularyUnavailableError` and `textUnder` in `kinds.ts` and `StakeholderKinds` in `kindReader.ts` are taken), and the import of `resolvePredicates` in `kinds.ts` is its own line beside the 0.1.0 `import type { StakeholderPredicates }` line;
`forgetStakeholderKindReaders` (`kindReader.ts` line 740) loses the line `treesByOrigin.clear();`, because the type-tree readers are not taken;

the header comment of each file is a new, shorter one, and comments that name a host, a person, an agent or a ticket are reworded (in 0.2.0: `Cycle214 GAPP214.22d`, `GAPP214.22d rig`, `Cycle214 s8` and `Agent.Scaling M3k F1` are dropped from the comments of `resolveStakeholderKinds`, `readShortcuts` and `stakeholderKindsOf`); no code changed.
